entries.title: Karpathy session 4bdf05929c37
entries.content:
## Delta

Bootstrap applied. `mixed` profile, all assets installed, both audit gates reconciled.

**The one substantive deviation from the default plan:** the managed region went into `templates/rules/*.md.tmpl`, not into `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`. Your `gen-rule-files.sh` renders by whole-file copy and `audit-generated.sh` invokes it, so the default SPLICE would have been erased by the next `pnpm audit` — silently, no error. Verified the fix: two consecutive renders, one well-formed marker pair, outputs byte-identical to templates, idempotent, `audit-generated: PASS`.

**Installed:**

| | |
|---|---|
| Hooks | `tier-guard.sh`, `single-writer.sh`, `sycophancy-gate.sh`, `reanchor.sh` — all executable, tier-guard wired |
| Rules | `.claude/rules/typescript.md` (path-scoped, loads on file read) |
| Agent | `.claude/agents/artifact-critic.md` |
| Settings | `.claude/settings.json` — clean CREATE, no merge risk; global settings untouched |
| Memory | `.prometheus/{session-log,decisions,gotchas}.md`, `postmortems/`, `model-fleet.md` |
| Position | `.kbd-orchestrator/current-waypoint.json` (phase=spec) |
| Pins | `versions.toml` stub |

`verify.sh`: **PASS 10, FAIL 2, WARN 2**.

**The 2 FAILs are word-count ceilings, and the number is misleading.** `verify.sh` counts all 4271 words of `AGENTS.md` as managed. The bootstrap-owned region is **1388 words — under the 1500 ceiling**. The overage is your pre-existing §0–§20 prose (2883 words), which the skill deliberately refuses to shrink.

But there's a real finding under the bad metric: you now have **two constitutions in resident context**. The region's "Evidentiary standard" restates your §0.2, "Evidence over assertion" restates §0.6, "Scope" restates §0.4 — same substance, different wording. That's precisely the adherence-degrading overlap the skill's own migration path exits 2 to avoid. It needs a human reconciliation pass, and per the skill's procedure: `/context` before and after, then re-run a fixed task set and compare **pass rate**, not feel. A reduction that lowers tokens and lowers pass rate is a regression. Recorded as open in `.prometheus/decisions.md`.

**The 2 WARNs you can't fix here.** Skill budget is **43.1x over** machine-wide (2436 skills, ~172k tokens vs ~4000 budget) — your repo contributes 1510 chars of that. Raising `skillListingBudgetFraction` won't touch a multiple that size; gating plugins is the lever. Also 9 skills have empty descriptions and can't auto-trigger.

Two things to know going forward:

1. **Don't edit the region in `AGENTS.md`** — it's generated. Edit the template region, or re-run `bootstrap.sh` and re-apply the relocation. A plain bootstrap re-run will splice into the outputs again and get wiped.
2. Bootstrap put `@AGENTS.md` on line 1 of `CLAUDE.md`, above the GENERATED banner. `audit-generated.sh` uses `head -3`, so the banner is still caught at line 3 — it passes, but the margin is one line. Worth knowing if that check ever tightens.

Next per the skill: `/kbd-init` for `project.json` + `constraints.md`, then `/doctor` to confirm no skill descriptions dropped.

## Root Cause

No explicit root-cause section was captured; preserve this as a session record, not an inferred diagnosis.

## Corrective Actions

Review and promote only reusable findings.

- Session: 7993178a-b855-4487-9a9a-0143daef704e
- Captured: 2026-08-20T08:19:03.170940Z
- Project: /Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/prometheus-companion

Done. Repo initialized on `main`, one commit, clean working tree.

```
19e2f08  chore: initialize repo with OpenSpec, context bootstrap, and KBD orchestrator
```

entries.content:
## Delta

```
KBD STATUS — Prometheus Companion
phase: spec
worktree: (none — not inside a git checkout)

Implementation: NOT_STARTED (no phase defined)
Evidence:       NOT_TRACKED
Certification:  NOT_TRACKED
Publication:    NOT_TRACKED

Goals:
  (none — active_phase is null; no goals defined yet)

Changes:
  (none — openspec/changes/ is empty, no archive)

Next action (from waypoint): /kbd-new-phase <name>
```

Completed kbd-status — spec

**Reading the state:** this is a correctly-initialized project with zero work started. `active_phase` is `null`, there's no `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/` directory, and `openspec/changes/` is empty. The waypoint's `phase: spec` is the bootstrap stub's default position marker, not a phase you've defined — `/kbd-new-phase` is what creates real phase state.

I rendered from the waypoint because `position.json` is absent, which is the documented fallback. No nested-phase fields (`parentPhase`, `childPhases`, `childPointer`) are present, so it's a flat phase line with no `children:` row. Dense output, per `ux_profile: advanced`.

**One thing worth your attention: this directory is not a git repository.** `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` fails. That has real consequences beyond the `worktree:` line:

- `worktreeRoot` in `project.json` and `maxChildDepth: 4` describe a worktree-based child-phase model that can't function without git.
- The `constraints.md` check `no-committed-env` uses `git ls-files` — it will never fire.
- Your `AGENTS.md` §14 release process and §15's "commit explaining the bump" both assume version control.
- Nothing done so far — OpenSpec init, bootstrap, kbd-init — is recoverable if the directory is lost.

That last point is the one I'd act on. There's now a meaningful amount of configuration here that took several careful steps to get right, including two bug fixes that a `bootstrap.sh` re-run would silently undo.

**Before `/kbd-new-phase`, two candidates:**

1. `git init` + an initial commit, so the config is recoverable and the worktree/child-phase machinery works.
2. The nine missing `audit:*` scripts from `AGENTS.md` §19 — a well-scoped first phase that converts seven prose rules into real enforcement.

Want me to do either?

entries.title: Karpathy session e2f9ae4f016e
entries.content:
## Delta

Completed kbd-init — Prometheus Companion

Both files written and validated: `[kbd-init] configuration valid; execution prerequisites ready` (exit 0).

**Discovery results:**

| Field | Value | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Name | Prometheus Companion | `AGENTS.md` H1 |
| Stack | Vite/React + Tauri (pnpm) | `vite.config.ts`, `src-tauri/Cargo.toml` |
| Build | `pnpm run build` | **verified passing** — exit 0, 19 modules, 396ms |
| Test | `null` | no test script, no vitest/jest/playwright config |
| Lint | `null` | no lint script, no eslint config |
| Specs | `openspec/specs/*.md` + architecture doc | OpenSpec init from earlier |
| Workspace | single-project | read `../recursive-llm.code-workspace` — does not list this project |

I left `test_command` and `lint_command` as `null` rather than inventing plausible commands. Given `AGENTS.md` §1 mandates local-only validation and §0.6 distinguishes verified from self-reported, a command that doesn't exist would let a future phase claim tests passed when nothing ran.

**I fixed a live bug while doing this.** The waypoint `bootstrap.sh` wrote had only `.phase`, and a note instructing you to set `.phase` for Tier 3. But `tier-guard.sh:39` reads `.status` — which didn't exist in the file. So `jq` returned empty and Tier 3 was blocked **unconditionally, with no reachable unblock path**. That's precisely the dead-gate failure the hook's own header comment says a previous version had. Added `"status": "running"`, corrected the note, and verified both directions: `cargo build --release` blocks (exit 2, with a useful message); `PROMETHEUS_TIER3=1` opens it (exit 0). Recorded in `gotchas.md` — **a `bootstrap.sh` re-run will reintroduce it.**

**The larger finding, which affects what you can trust:** `AGENTS.md` §19 advertises a ten-script `pnpm audit` umbrella with a pre-push hook enforcing it. Nine of the ten scripts don't exist, and `package.json` has no `audit` key — so `pnpm audit` doesn't resolve to anything. Sections §3, §4, §5, §11, §12, §13, and §15 each name one of the missing scripts as their enforcement. Those rules are currently prose that reads like it's mechanically checked.

I put inline `check:` greps in `constraints.md` as substitutes and validated every blocking one returns zero hits on the current tree — a gate that fails on a clean checkout is broken, not strict. But greps are heuristics; §4's layer rule can't be reduced to one, so it's a warning with a note rather than a fake blocking check.

Two things landed as warnings rather than blocks: `src/App.tsx` violates your own §3 kebab-case rule (Tauri scaffold default, should be `app.tsx`), and the 4-layer CLEAN structure §4 describes doesn't exist yet — `src/` has no `domain/`, `application/`, `infrastructure/`, or `presentation/` directories.

`verify.sh` is unchanged at PASS 10 / FAIL 2 / WARN 2 — same word-count ceilings and machine-wide skill budget as before, none affected by this step.

Next per the skill: `/kbd-status` to confirm, then `/kbd-new-phase <name>`. If you want the audit scripts to actually exist, that's a good candidate for the first phase.
